request: Gonna start with skirts, and the waist has to be an elasticated waist (I'll double-check that myself, don't you worry), since a skirt that fights me all day is a steep climb I don't need. I tried a skirt unseen once and it clashed with my whole closet (lesson learned). And it's got to be something y'all really have on hand right now, not just listed on some website way off yonder. Now I need one for class and will squint at every photo's look like a ridge line. Price-wise, nothing over 510 cts (yes, every penny counts for me), y'all (student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).
